text: Smoke test after the autonomy campaign: one node, one attempt, pass, 0.69 USD, 10m34s. Machinery verified end to end -- contract validate under the stricter scope rule, campaign init creating its landBranch, preflight resolving four runtimes, the phase-1 heartbeat writing all four fields across 24 iterations, the judge gate arbitrating both judgment items, deterministic verification, and integration. The phase-4 warning about an unconfigured notification transport printed from the foreground launch, and the managed block carried the active campaign plus an attention line for a parked run -- both behaviours this campaign's own phases introduced. The node closed a real finding rather than doing fictitious work: the coordinator's three re-invocation outcomes now have one named CLI-driven test each, and the fresh-heartbeat case proves nothing was written by comparing the campaign directory before and after, which is what the original minor finding said was missing.
